scope: scripts/qualify_library_preservation.py on a frozen Debug build of ce021da (D:\wp\b14), owned TIA V21 scratch projects (CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 plus a second CPU), 477/477 steps, 0 snapshot mismatches: all 19 PLC library change kinds applied in one project with an owned user global library, each with an exact diff of an independent snapshot (every block, PLC data type and tag-table XML of both PLCs by native payload hash, every project/global library type, version, folder and master copy, every committed project-library version's document export); per kind a stale-identity refusal and a wrong-previewHash refusal without change; LibraryUpdateCleanupRisk refusals while library objects lacked OB-rooted references, were reachable only through the updated FB, or were an unrelated unreferenced type; fresh Portal reopen equal to the last verified state, with the upgraded DMC V19 PLC library and the global-library archive equal to their recorded rows; then one more change per kind restored from its checkpoint into new locations, each equal to its pre-change snapshot (library_create/library_upgrade: checkpoint-free refusal, outputs retained); and in a separate scratch library_save persisted a failed master-copy change's partial global-library state (duplicate-IP compile failure, recovery_required), refusing an unrelated recoveryChangeId, and restoring that save returned the library to its state before the failed change. 197 retained library observations (64 lock receipts) validate.
limitations: One owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 project with a second CPU at PLC-root scope and the dependency fixture; software units, namespaces, protected and HMI types are qualified by their own runs.
Implementation-only FB releases; interface changes and runtime behavior are covered by local.library_releases.20261026.

library_cleanup ran PreserveDefaultVersionOfUnusedTypes on selected types; DeleteUnusedTypes and folder selections are not exercised. library_harmonize renamed instances; differing library folders and PLC groups are not constructible in V21.
library_upgrade used DMC Open Library V19 PLC (MIT); a type's own status and default rows may change with any change of that type, every other key is exact.
